name: 061.2 — Changed on a native checkbox, and widget:value() reading one
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 061.2: widget:value() answers on a borrowed control, Changed fires on one of the client's own checkboxes carrying the value it is about to take, cancelling leaves it unflipped, ev:resend() flips it, and an addon that owns the enclosing control never receives the key twice.
